name: Mitsubishi Electric US, Inc., Industrial Automation
old_description: Mitsubishi Electric US, Industrial Automation announces the launch of the GOT3000 Series HMI, the next generation of human-machine interfaces, to its existing lineup. GOT3000 delivers faster performance, enhanced security, and compatibility with prior GOT models. It delivers a practical path to modernization without the need for rip-and-replace upgrades.
about:
Mitsubishi Electric US, Inc., Industrial Automation is headquartered in Vernon Hills, Illinois. The division operates as part of Mitsubishi Electric Corporation, which celebrated its 100th anniversary in February 2021. The U.S. automation business supports customers across the Americas from a single facility that houses manufacturing, engineering, training, service, and warehousing functions.

The company designs and manufactures a broad range of factory automation equipment, including programmable logic controllers (MELSEC series), human-machine interfaces (GOT series), variable frequency drives (FREQROL series), AC servo systems (MELSERVO), industrial robots (MELFA and ASSISTA collaborative robots), CNC controllers, low-voltage power distribution products, laser processing machines, and electrical discharge machines. It also provides engineering software, network products, system integration, technical support, repair services, and training programs.

Its customers span mining, water and wastewater treatment, automotive, education, and general manufacturing. Concrete examples include DICISA in mining, Bertelkamp Automation for municipal water systems, Renault Group for e-motor production, Kettering University for hands-on automation education, and Usinage Précision Bilodeau for precision machining.

The division’s stated mission is to support industrial automation needs in the Americas by combining sales, marketing, service, engineering, and manufacturing resources in one location. It emphasizes rapid repair turnaround using custom parts, on-site training, and a culture of continuous improvement (Kaizen) that places it among the top five global patent filers. The e-F@ctory initiative leverages IoT and big data to create smart factory solutions.
